item.title: Time-JEPA: Grounding Video World Models with Physical Time Series
item.description: Time-JEPA: Grounding Video World Models with Physical Time Series. arXiv preprint, 2026-10-14, v1. A shared video encoder learns from aligned physical-state targets during training, then runs on video alone. Matched controls test whether alignment matters. Takeaway: Treat synchronized physical measurements as training supervision, and separately test what the frozen representation preserves. Caveat: These are supervised readout results, not demonstrated wearable deployment, continual learning or universal planning gains.

item.title: RL-Guided Temporal Localization for Dual-Channel Retrieval in Long-Horizon Agent Memory
item.description: RL-Guided Temporal Localization for Dual-Channel Retrieval in Long-Horizon Agent Memory. arXiv preprint, 2026-10-16, v1. A trained temporal locator adds date-based candidates before answer generation. With the same memory pool and top-20 unit budget, LifeBench accuracy rises from 52.21% to 61.52%; transfer to LoCoMo exposes temporal-localization failures. Takeaway: Learn when to retrieve, then combine temporal and semantic evidence while keeping the answer model fixed. Caveat: Synthetic, accurately timestamped histories; LoCoMo temporal accuracy trails TiMem. Gold evidence/date supervision and a costly reinforcement-learning run are required.

item.title: BeJEPA: A Goal-Conditioned Humanoid Behavior World Model via Unsupervised RL
item.description: BeJEPA: A Goal-Conditioned Humanoid Behavior World Model via Unsupervised RL. arXiv preprint, 2026-10-16, v1. A humanoid policy learns from a next-state predictor and a discounted summary of behavioral continuation. Balanced model-predictive refinement improves global tracking in the paper's simulation protocol, while local posture and hardware evidence remain qualified. Takeaway: Couple local physical prediction with a goal-conditioned future summary to train world-anchored control. Caveat: Hardware evidence is qualitative; measured MPC latency and training GPU-hours are unreported. SONIC retains better AMASS local posture, and deployment weights remain frozen.

item.title: ECG-SDI: Single-lead Electrocardiogram Enables Continuous Sleep Depth Index Profiling and Scalable Digital Biomarkers for Sleep Health
item.description: ECG-SDI: Single-lead Electrocardiogram Enables Continuous Sleep Depth Index Profiling and Scalable Digital Biomarkers for Sleep Health. arXiv preprint, 2026-10-16, v1. A single-lead ECG model learns ordered sleep depth across retrospective cohorts. The review separates raw stage agreement from reference-label-normalized biomarkers and uncontrolled CPAP changes. Takeaway: An accessible ECG research direction, with strong cohort evidence but no label-free home validation. Caveat: Normalized outputs and several biomarkers use reference sleep stages; uncertainty bootstraps epochs and wearable accuracy is unmeasured.

item.title: PulseBound: Future-Beat State Forecasting Under an Explicit Information Boundary
item.description: PulseBound: Future-Beat State Forecasting Under an Explicit Information Boundary. arXiv preprint, 2026-10-12, v2. Prefix-only normalization and suffix replacement make future-beat prediction auditable. Matched forecasting and transfer gains come with explicit tokenizer, preprocessing and dataset-split limits. Takeaway: The reusable idea is an information-access contract that can be attacked and tested. Caveat: The frozen tokenizer saw full processed MIMIC before its patient split; the audit starts after upstream preprocessing and device feasibility is unmeasured.

item.title: Few-Shot Prototype Head Adaptation for On-Device ECG Personalization on PSoC 6
item.description: Few-Shot Prototype Head Adaptation for On-Device ECG Personalization on PSoC 6. arXiv preprint, 2026-10-05, v1. Frozen embeddings and class means provide lightweight ECG personalization on PSoC 6. An independent code-and-dataset audit finds one participant crossing the development/test boundary. Takeaway: The hardware measurements are useful; population-generalization claims need a corrected split and external validation. Caveat: Records 201 and 202 belong to the same person but are assigned to DS1 and DS2; no corrected rerun quantifies the impact. The 17× timing claim is host-only.

item.title: HexaShell: A Thin Harness for Exploring the Limits of VLM Agents as Robot Coding Agents
item.description: HexaShell: A Thin Harness for Exploring the Limits of VLM Agents as Robot Coding Agents. arXiv preprint, 2026-10-16, v1. A fixed coding model uses calibrated cameras, geometric measurements and a repair agent to develop robot tools. Frozen tools reach 39.7% success under RoboDojo's aggregation, while fine contact and paused-simulation latency remain substantial limitations. Takeaway: Persistent software repairs can improve simulated manipulation without changing model weights. Caveat: The leaderboard comparison uses different evaluation samples; development includes inherited tools and human assistance, and the full harness is not released.

item.title: BizAgentBench: Unveiling Hidden Challenges in Deploying Long-Horizon Agents for Real-World Business
item.description: BizAgentBench: Unveiling Hidden Challenges in Deploying Long-Horizon Agents for Real-World Business. arXiv preprint, 2026-10-18, v2. A synthetic payments benchmark scores goal attainment, valid process and protection of records across complete execution histories. Deterministic checks reveal gaps hidden by final-state success and test the effect of supplying documents and customer facts. Takeaway: An acceptable final result is insufficient when a workflow can violate constraints along the way. Caveat: Fifty synthetic tasks do not certify real-world safety. Unequal repetitions and a small sample limit model-ranking claims.

item.title: Speculative Sampling in Interactive Video Generation
item.description: Speculative Sampling in Interactive Video Generation. arXiv preprint, 2026-10-14, v1. A serving controller caches joint video predictions, releases a small protected prefix and replaces uncommitted futures when instructions change. Matched large-chunk experiments improve responsiveness, but a short-chunk LTX setting becomes slower and stalls more. Takeaway: Separate prediction size from commitment size, then measure response time, stalls and total resource use together. Caveat: Benefits depend on model, scheduling and hardware. Frequent updates waste predictions, and lower per-GPU activity is not evidence of lower total cost.

item.title: T2-z: Test-Time Optimization of Environment Latents for Robotic World Models
item.description: T2-z: Test-Time Optimization of Environment Latents for Robotic World Models. arXiv preprint, 2026-10-15, v1. Optimizes a 32-dimensional environment latent against observed interactions. Takeaway: Optimize an environment latent from observed interactions while keeping shared model weights fixed. Caveat: Adaptation adds substantial compute, and small task-specific tests do not establish long-horizon reliability.

item.title: All-in-One Memory: Process-Rewarded Reinforcement Learning for Memory Agents
item.description: All-in-One Memory: Process-Rewarded Reinforcement Learning for Memory Agents. arXiv preprint, 2026-10-15, v1. Offline reinforcement learning coordinates retrieval, notes, skipping, and stopping. Takeaway: Train retrieval, note-writing, skipping, and stopping around source-linked evidence. Caveat: Aggregate gains hide task regressions; conflicting retrieval settings and incomplete release details limit reproducibility.

item.title: MJev-Spatial: System One Spatial Intelligence via Native Attention Matching
item.description: MJev-Spatial: System One Spatial Intelligence via Native Attention Matching. arXiv preprint, 2026-10-15, v1. Scores spatial candidates directly with pretrained attention matching. Takeaway: Use a specialized candidate-scoring interface for structured spatial decisions. Caveat: Headline gains combine the interface with extensive training; matched readout ablations are mixed.

item.title: Speculative Forcing for Efficient Autoregressive Video Generation
item.description: Speculative Forcing for Efficient Autoregressive Video Generation. arXiv preprint, 2026-10-15, v1. Commits converged video tokens early while refining the difficult ones. Takeaway: Adapt computation token by token while retaining accepted outputs as context. Caveat: Reported speed excludes the video encoder and decoder; aggressive acceptance can degrade quality.

item.title: FDE-Gym: The Last Mile of AI Delivery
item.description: FDE-Gym: The Last Mile of AI Delivery. arXiv preprint, 2026-10-15, v1. Measures operational delivery after incident and stakeholder-contact costs. Takeaway: Evaluate constraint discovery and implementation against held-out business outcomes. Caveat: Ninety-five tasks share twenty scenarios, contact costs are designed, and no measured human baseline is available.

item.title: Memorilla: Latent Semantic Memory for LLMs
item.description: Memorilla: Latent Semantic Memory for LLMs. arXiv preprint preprint, 2026-10-15, v1. A learned reader compresses document embeddings into continuous inputs for a frozen language model. Takeaway: Separate persistent storage from query-conditioned readout. Caveat: Bounded decoder input does not imply bounded retrieval or storage; substantial supervised training is required.

item.title: Hy-Memory-30B-A3B: Attributed Reinforcement Learning for Long-Term Memory Writing
item.description: Hy-Memory-30B-A3B: Attributed Reinforcement Learning for Long-Term Memory Writing. arXiv preprint preprint, 2026-10-15, v1. A trained writer receives utility and storage rewards while a separate reader answers questions. Takeaway: Attribute reward to particular memory-writing decisions. Caveat: Small benchmark margins and missing component ablations limit causal conclusions.

item.title: Teaching PPG How, Not Who: Fixed-Effects Distillation from ECG
item.description: Teaching PPG How, Not Who: Fixed-Effects Distillation from ECG. arXiv preprint preprint, 2026-10-07, v1 (archive pick). A small bridge learns within-recording changes from electrical heart signals to optical pulse signals. Takeaway: Subtract stable recording offsets when learning changing physiological state. Caveat: External blood-pressure prediction fails a simple baseline; patient-disjoint generalization is not established.

item.title: Spectral Considerations on Unsupervised Time-domain EEG Representation Learning with Deep Networks
item.description: Spectral Considerations on Unsupervised Time-domain EEG Representation Learning with Deep Networks. arXiv preprint preprint, 2026-10-12, v1 (archive pick). Time-domain reconstruction may prioritize high-amplitude components and neglect weaker frequencies. Takeaway: Audit individual frequency bands instead of trusting average reconstruction loss. Caveat: Synthetic classification performance is not evidence of clinical diagnosis.

item.title: Predicting Cognitive Tasks from Single-Channel EEG through Task-Semantic Alignment
item.description: Predicting Cognitive Tasks from Single-Channel EEG through Task-Semantic Alignment. arXiv preprint preprint, 2026-10-10, v1 (archive pick). A shared language space connects task labels across electroencephalography studies. Takeaway: Separate task novelty from participant and source novelty in evaluation. Caveat: Source shortcuts remain plausible; transfer and within-recording calibration scores are different settings.

item.title: Waypoint-OPD: Transferring RL-Induced Policy Shifts via Gated On-Policy Distillation
item.description: Waypoint-OPD: Transferring RL-Induced Policy Shifts via Gated On-Policy Distillation. arXiv preprint preprint, 2026-10-15, v1. Three saved teacher versions weight stable preference changes during student training. Takeaway: A teacher’s learning path can identify which changes deserve transfer. Caveat: Same-family model assumptions and checkpoint selection limit generalization of reported gains.

item.title: OpenGCUA: Toward a Fully Open Stack for Generalist Computer Use
item.description: OpenGCUA: Toward a Fully Open Stack for Generalist Computer Use. arXiv preprint preprint, 2026-10-15, v1. Programs branch on intermediate results instead of executing only rigid action lists. Takeaway: Use intermediate execution feedback to shorten interaction loops. Caveat: Main results use an offline subset; fewer steps do not automatically mean lower latency or tokens.

item.title: OmniCompass: A Holistic Benchmark for Omni-Modal Video Grounding and Understanding
item.description: OmniCompass: A Holistic Benchmark for Omni-Modal Video Grounding and Understanding. arXiv preprint preprint, 2026-10-13, v1 (archive pick). Paired text and image references test consistent, correct video grounding and understanding. Takeaway: Measure correctness across paired references rather than agreement alone. Caveat: Different frame budgets and constrained localization protocols complicate model comparisons.

item.title: Cortex: Consolidating Context into Parametric Memory
item.description: Cortex: Consolidating Context into Parametric Memory. arXiv preprint, 2026-10-14, v1. Can useful context survive after the prompt disappears? A careful look at learning new behavior while preserving the old. Takeaway: Retest older examples after every update, even when the original weights stay frozen. Caveat: Fifty compatible factual edits are not indefinite lifelong learning. Replay also changes the optimization budget.

item.title: Latent Compaction with Test-Time Training
item.description: Latent Compaction with Test-Time Training. arXiv preprint, 2026-10-14, v1. Compress a document’s attention cache for questions that have not been asked yet. Takeaway: Preserve both what a memory returns and how strongly it competes for attention. Caveat: 16× describes logical key-value compression, not measured physical memory savings or faster inference. Preparation is expensive.

item.title: Enhancing Latent World Models with Associative Memory
item.description: Enhancing Latent World Models with Associative Memory. arXiv preprint, 2026-10-14, v1. A compact memory bank helps a world model predict latent states and plan from images. Takeaway: Compact latent conditioning can help planning, but a learned prior is not a growing episodic memory. Caveat: Small simulation study; no inference-time write rule. The paper does not clearly define its error bars.

item.title: TimeCap: A Scalable Open-Source Pipeline for Captioning Wearable Health Time-Series Data
item.description: TimeCap: A Scalable Open-Source Pipeline for Captioning Wearable Health Time-Series Data. arXiv preprint, 2026-10-15, v1. Auditable rule-based captions for wearable time series, with preliminary prediction gains and clinical limitations. Takeaway: Use deterministic signal-language rules when reproducible annotations matter. Caveat: Self-reported outcomes, only fifteen positive atrial-fibrillation test participants and no external clinical validation; caption access is restricted.

item.title: PPG-Bench: A Unified Benchmark for PPG Foundation Models
item.description: PPG-Bench: A Unified Benchmark for PPG Foundation Models. arXiv preprint, 2026-10-09, v1. A controlled benchmark asks when pulse-signal foundation models beat simple physiological and general-purpose controls. Takeaway: Compare pulse-signal models with constant, physiological-feature and general time-series controls using participant-level evaluation. Caveat: Retrospective benchmark results do not establish clinical utility. Confidence-interval overlap is not equivalence, and released recipes may not be optimally tuned.

item.title: Detecting Agitation Before Behavioral Escalation in Autistic Youth Through Multimodal Wearable Sensing
item.description: Detecting Agitation Before Behavioral Escalation in Autistic Youth Through Multimodal Wearable Sensing. arXiv preprint, 2026-09-21, v2, revised 2026-09-25 (archive pick). A small personalized sensing study reveals how temporal evaluation changes apparent agitation-detection performance. Takeaway: Audit personalization, labels, sensor contributions and chronological splits before treating a sensing model as an early-warning system. Caveat: Fifteen participants in clinician-led sessions; no unseen-child validation or demonstrated prevention of escalation. Earlier windows were not independently labeled as agitation.

item.title: Are We Overthinking One-Step Generation?
item.description: Are We Overthinking One-Step Generation?. arXiv preprint, 2026-10-14, v1. Reconstruction pretraining improves the quality-compute frontier of one-step image generation. Takeaway: An easy reconstruction objective can prepare a generator for harder distribution matching; compare the complete quality-compute frontier. Caveat: Compute multipliers depend on the baseline. Video prediction resets from real observations and does not establish stable simulation or improved control.

item.title: Generative Representation Learning for Scalable Latent Tokenization
item.description: Generative Representation Learning for Scalable Latent Tokenization. arXiv preprint, 2026-10-14, v1. Representation geometry learned from predictive information is evaluated under a full generative-training compute budget. Takeaway: Learn representation geometry from conditional prediction advantage and evaluate generation under the full training budget. Caveat: Large encoder-compute savings are extrapolated scaling projections, not measured end-to-end speedups. No runnable release was verified at review time.

item.title: Hybrid Reasoning Agents
item.description: Hybrid Reasoning Agents. arXiv preprint, 2026-10-13, v1. Continuous internal reasoning combines with explicit text tool calls and persistent mixed attention state. Takeaway: Combine latent recurrence with text actions and persistent mixed state, then measure complete latency, memory and correctness. Caveat: The attention cache grows. Estimated decoding cost excludes prompt processing and external tools; readable latent readouts are not proof of faithful explanations.
